description: Controlled vocabulary for machine-readable reviewer annotations (SPEC.md §9 verification admin mode). Codes are stable identifiers consumed by re-research prompts, the verify gate, and quality rollups; labels and descriptions are for reviewer UI. The type-level mirror is ReviewReasonCode in @deep-fryer/core, guard-tested against this file.

reasons.label: Wrong value
reasons.description: The reported number does not match what the cited source says.

reasons.label: Wrong source
reasons.description: The citation points at a page or document that does not carry this claim.

reasons.label: Outdated
reasons.description: A newer vintage of the same series exists and should be used.

reasons.label: Wrong geography
reasons.description: The value covers a different geography than the portrait's region (e.g. citywide where the borough was required).

reasons.label: Misread source
reasons.description: The source is right but was misinterpreted — wrong table, wrong denominator, wrong universe, or unit confusion.

reasons.label: Better source exists
reasons.description: A higher-tier or more authoritative source publishes this indicator (source-tiers-exhausted-in-order).

reasons.label: Methodology issue
reasons.description: The scoring math, threshold mapping, or indicator definition is questionable for this claim.

reasons.label: Gap confirmed
reasons.description: The reviewer confirms no acceptable data exists — the honest gap stands (gaps-outrank-guesses).

reasons.label: Other
reasons.description: None of the codes fit — the note text carries the reasoning.
